name: Sheet metal and panels
summary: Flat and corrugated steel and aluminium sheet: appliance cases, roofing, ducting, signs and panels.
uses: Heat shields, stove parts and solar cookers
identify: Washer, dryer and fridge cabinets, computer cases, HVAC ducts, road signs, roofing and shed panels. A magnet sticks to steel but not to aluminium. Galvanised steel has a dull grey zinc coat: don’t weld or burn it indoors, as the fumes make you ill.
test: Look for rust-through and cracks at bends. Thin rusty spots dent easily under a thumb or screwdriver.

decay.note: Lasts. Bare steel rusts outdoors; aluminium and galvanised steel last decades.
